remarks: Discover this professionally updated one-bedroom, one-bathroom apartment at 106 Woodside Green, Unit 1A. This unit features elegant hardwood floors throughout and is bathed in an abundance of natural light, creating a sophisticated and welcoming ambiance.  The oversized living/dining room combo offers a generous and versatile space, perfect for both relaxing and entertaining. The apartment includes a modern galley kitchen and large closets, providing efficient use of space and ample storage.  Located directly across from Scalzi Park, this residence boasts an exceptional location. Enjoy the convenience of walking to the train station and downtown, where a wide array of fine restaurants and shops are just a short stroll away. This property presents an ideal blend of classic charm and modern convenience in a highly desirable neighborhood.
